name: progenitor-node-video
description: YouTube-style explainer for the Progenitor Node Model, generated with Remotion

scripts.prep: npm run data && npm run voice && npm run music
scripts.render: remotion render Explainer out/explainer-raw.mp4 && npm run master
scripts.master: ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/explainer-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/explainer.mp4
